nodes.label: Station Owner Guide Video (guide.html)
nodes.rationale: Nine steps at about eight seconds each with no voiceover, because the pacing is measured for reading rather than listening: one step on screen, one sentence, and a picture of exactly what the owner will see when he opens his phone. It reuses the same stage as explainer.html so the same capture script renders it to MP4 in both sizes.

nodes.label: Owner Guide Step Sequence
nodes.rationale: Title, signing in, phone number and password, the «لوحة محطتي» dashboard, the products panel, confirming availability, congestion, the daily update habit, the shareable availability image carrying station name, available products and date, the station link, and the closing card.
